title: chrysanthemum bulbosum
intro: Chrysanthemum bulbosum, commonly known as the Hardy Chrysanthemum or Autumn Chrysanthemum, is a type of flowering plant in the daisy family. This plant is believed to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce stress and improve sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Chrysanthemum bulbosum include calming the nervous system, lowering blood pressure, and reducing fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
